thread:
Mira Chen: pinging runtime + infra + security folks for quick eyes on PR #42188 — shadow-cache quota defaults change. planning a 10% canary for 2h next Tue. small change but affects eviction behaviour. diff snippet:
```yaml
# runtime/config/cache.yaml
shadow_cache:
  enabled: true
  default_quota: 0.12  # fraction of GPU mem to reserve per model
  per_model_overrides: {}
```
Can we confirm owners and any blocking concerns? :eyes:

Sam Patel: quick q — any perf numbers or regressions from lab runs? tail latency, OOM behavior?

Mira Chen: ran bench in staging: no OOMs across 200 concurrent sessions, avg token throughput +1%, p99 latency +3% at 512-context workloads. steady-state memory use down ~12% for large models. linked a short runbook and raw logs: https://internal.gists/reports/42188 (internal)

Alex Gomez: do we need infra touches for rollout? k8s pod memory limits / autoscaler changes? rollback plan?

Mira Chen: no k8s schema changes. this is a runtime flag and per-model cap — nothing that changes pod resources. rollback = flip feature flag off + re-deploy runtime (quick). I'll include explicit rollback steps in the PR description.

Priya Nair: security note — config exposes per-model caps; who can edit these values? need audit trail + ensure config writes are scoped. also add to runbook: who to contact on anomalies.

Mira Chen: agreed. access is gated by infra-admin role today but i'll add KMS/audit pointer and a short ACL note in the PR. will add you to reviewers for security sign-off.

Jonah Reed: platform side — who owns the canary watch? dashboards to check?

Sam Patel: I can own the canary window. i'll watch token latency SLO, p99 latency, and the `runtime.oom_count` metric. Ping me when canary starts and i’ll keep a slack thread open.

ci-bot: CI: build passed for PR #42188 — unit tests ✅ integration tests ✅ smoke tests ✅ (run id: 2026-03-12-08).

Mira Chen: thanks! assigning owners: Sam = canary owner, Alex = rollback owner, Priya = security signoff. scheduling canary Tue 15:00 PT. If no blocking comments by EOD Fri, i'll merge and schedule canary with the above owners. tagging: @Sam Patel @Alex Gomez @Priya Nair :white_check_mark:

Sam Patel: ack, i'll prepare a short checklist (dashboard links + alert thresholds) and post it here before the canary.

Alex Gomez: acked — i'll be on-call for rollback window. one ask: please include the exact model list that will get the per-model overrides so infra can correlate.

Mira Chen: will add model list and verification steps. thanks everyone for the quick responses.

Priya Nair: i'll take a quick look for ACL/audit and comment by tomorrow. if anything security-y shows up i'll flag immediately.

Mira Chen: great — marking this as actioned for now. will follow up in PR with the checklist and links. :rocket:
